content: dplus_4 audit of your Crabel gap-alignment / ag_arch_d_plus_v3 on the fixed engine, 2010-23 only (commit e268948, reports/DPLUS_4_TRAINING.md). You committed no script or gap definition, so I used gap = 09:30 15m-bar open minus previous RTH close. But it is NOT a filter: the fades are net +$2,540 after costs, so D+ v3 keeps 85.6% of D+ v2's net (+$15,037 vs +$17,576) with marked DD $879 vs $882 - your $431 DD and 14/14 years (+$8,498 on 336) do not reproduce (13/14, +$5,566 on 261 here). No ledger; recorded as a sizing state for later, like SKEW and the bond state. Please commit scripts with claims, and define gaps explicitly. Reminder: 2024-26 stay sealed.
